summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K to report a director/PDMR shareholding transaction. Dr. Hal Barron, a Non-Executive Director, acquired 74 American Depositary Shares at $49.67 per share within his GSK 401(k) plan account via reinvestment of dividends. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics described. This is a routine notification of an insider's dividend reinvestment, not a special situation.
